nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: In the Q2 FY26 call (October 2025), management guided FY26 revenue at ~₹12,500 crore with ~5% growth in FY27, and average margins of 15%+. Earlier, in Q4 FY25 (May 2025), they guided 8%-10% revenue growth and 15% PBT margins. The Q2 FY27 result (₹2,446.1 crore revenue, down 16.5%; PAT slump of 53.8%) falls short of these expectations.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so. And the coming year also, we should have may be another 5% growth over that
But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins
As the Director of Finance has brought out, we expect the revenue growth of anywhere between 8% to 10% and our PBT margins we expect around 15%

nse:106837394.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106837394.answer: Management did not give specific aggregate group revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27 in prior call transcripts. During the Q1 FY27 call (July 2026), they discussed strategy, noting retail margin pressure from online investments, full capitalization of Jio 5G, and strong O2C dynamics. Detailed aggregate numbers for Q2 FY27 were reported on the Q2 call (October 2026).

evidence.quote: So, as we increase the growth of digital revenues, margins have come down. It is a function of that. And that is a consistent trend over the last three quarters
EBITDA margin at 53.3%, EBIT Rs. 13,407 crores and profit after tax at Rs. 764 crores, the finance cost has gone up. It is really because we are now expensing it, we are not capitalizing it
It was an EBITDA of Rs.62,409 Crores, which is 24% up on a year-on￾year basis

nse:106836523.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836523.answer: Management stated on recent calls that revenue grew due to higher input costs and rapid memory price inflation, while margins looked optically lower. This matched the reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹1,593.2 crore (up 15% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 9.3%.

evidence.quote: The pass-through of higher input cost through corresponding increasing in selling prices resulted in a lower reported margin percentage, particularly in mobile and IT hardware business, despite the recovery of increased cost through pricing adjustments
As increased input costs were passed through increase in selling prices, percentage margins look optically lower, mostly in mobile and IT hardware business

nse:106823051.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106823051.answer: In November 2026, management explained an October 17 incident where eight weak intermediate TLS certificates were revoked. The affected public TLS business represented 1% of revenue, leading eMudhra to exit publicly trusted TLS certificate sales. Management reduced FY27 revenue guidance by INR 20–23 crore and PAT by INR 10–12 crore, expecting the impact to last two quarters.

evidence.quote: On October 17th, an independent researcher reported weak keys in eight intermediate certificates within one of our public TLS hierarchies created during a key-generation ceremony in April 2025
This affected only our publicly trusted TLS business, which was about 1% of our revenue
Given the limited returns from TLS relative to our overall business, we have decided to exit the sale of publicly trusted TLS certificates and focus fully on our core platform

nse:106845578.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106845578.answer: Management guided at the start of the year for revenue around INR 825 crore and PAT of INR 137 crore (25% growth). Following an October TLS security incident, management revised Q2 FY27 expectations on the Nov 2026 call to total income of about INR 800 crore and PAT around INR 125 crore. Actual reported Q2 FY27 revenue was INR 207 crore (+19.7% YoY) and PAT was INR 33.0 crore (+26.9% YoY).

evidence.quote: At the start of the year, we guided a revenue of about INR 825 crores and PAT of about INR 137 crores, about 25% PAT growth. We now expect our revenue to be about INR 800 crore and PAT of around INR 125 crore
We expect the incident to reduce our FY27 total income by about INR 20 crores to INR 23 crores and our PAT by about INR 10 crores to INR 12 crores, largely in the second half

nse:106834360.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834360.answer: Management stated on the Q1 FY27 call that it expected Q2 FY27 PRASK to grow by more than 25% year-on-year. On the recent Q2 FY27 call, management confirmed this actual result, reporting that PRASK grew by 31% year-on-year, though a net loss of 19 billion rupees was reported due to elevated fuel costs and seasonal softness.

evidence.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand￾supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year
Third, in this environment, we delivered a 31 percent increase in PRASK, which exceeded our guidance of more than 25 percent growth

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss raising money or issuing credit facilities in either call. In May 2025, management stated that the company holds Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 12,000 crores in cash and does not expect to take on debt for capex due to a healthy balance sheet, adding in October 2025 that it does not have much borrowings.

evidence.quote: As of now, we are having quite healthy Balance Sheet and we do not expect, but it will be based on the economic performance, we will see
I don't think it will be having any impact because we are not having any much borrowings, so it is almost the same

nse:106836275.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836275.answer: Management guided for high single-digit top-line growth for FY27 on recent calls (Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27). For Q2 FY27, revenue actually grew 35.0% YoY to ₹6,141.9 crore, exceeding the guided rate, while EBITDA margin improved to 27.9% from 26.0% a year ago.

evidence.quote: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year
Regarding the guidance, I think we'll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year

nse:106834087.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834087.answer: Management stated in Q1 FY27 that it expected full-year volume growth between 8% and 10% and PBDIT margins within an 18% to 20% band, with value growth higher than volume due to pricing. For Q2 FY27, actual standalone revenue rose 14.9% YoY, volume grew 6.4%, and PBDIT margin was 17.0%, meeting the volume growth expectations and remaining near the targeted band.

evidence.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27
We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management did not give specific revenue or margin guidance for Q2 FY27, stating in July 2026 that they had "no guidance on that." They provided broader directional views, expecting food delivery margins to remain flattish over the next 1–2 years (October 2026) and quick commerce long-term Adjusted EBITDA margins to reach 6% (July 2026).

evidence.quote: Sorry, Swapnil, we don't want to comment on the quarter right now, no guidance on that
Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish

nse:106836183.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106836183.answer: Management reported completing a ₹780 crore QIP in Q1 FY27 and a subsequent 60:40 partly paid rights issue to strengthen liquidity, deleverage, and gain financial flexibility. Most raised cash went toward adding capacity or paying down debt. Additionally, they plan to raise external equity directly into the cell company to expand capacity from 6 GWh to 20 GWh.

evidence.quote: The balance sheet strengthened during the quarter through the successful completion of a ₹780 crore QIP, giving us greater financial flexibility as we pursue the next phase of our growth
Most of the cash we have raised has gone either into adding capacity or into paying down debt during this period
Once we stabilise 6 GWh, over the next couple of quarters, we will definitely look to go to 20 GWh, and we will do that by bringing external equity into the cell company
